cues.text:
Before the dawn, the stone was sealed
The sorrow of the cross was real

But when the morning broke the night
The empty grave brought hope to light

The place where Jesus once had lain
Could never hold Him bound again

He rose in victory to save
And opened life beyond the grave

Risen Son, You have won the fight
You rose in glory, clothed in light

The grave is empty, Christ is risen
Our living hope, our sins forgiven

Jesus, You live forevermore
You are the Savior we adore

We lift our hearts and sing Your praise
Our risen Lord through all our days

Your wounded hands still bear the sign
Of love that gave its life for mine

The scars remain, but death is past
You rose to give us life that lasts

When fears return and shadows grow
Your risen life is what we know

Through You, our future rests secure
Your risen life will still endure

You rose in glory, clothed in light

The grave is empty, Christ is risen

Jesus, You live forevermore
You are the Savior we adore

We lift our hearts and sing Your praise
Our risen Lord through all our days

Because You live, we need not fear
Through every trial, You are near

And when we face our final breath
In You we rise beyond our death
